title: GeneratorGlobalSpecification
description: Requirements extracted from generator project specification documents. Extract only requirements explicitly supported by the document. Preserve the shortest exact source quotation and its one-based PDF page number for each entity. Use null when a value is not stated.

diesel_engine_type.description: The required engine cycle, cooling method, and fuel type.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation that states the engine type requirement.

cycles.description: All normalized engine cycles permitted or required by the document, such as four_stroke or two_stroke.

cooling_methods.description: All normalized engine cooling methods permitted or required by the document, such as water_cooled, liquid_cooled, or air_cooled.

fuel_types.description: All normalized engine fuel types permitted or required by the document, such as diesel or natural_gas.

cooling_requirements.description: The required engine cooling-system characteristics and coolant mixture.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation or quotations that state the cooling requirements.

source_page.description: One-based PDF page containing the primary source_text.

cooling_system.description: Normalized cooling-system type, such as closed_loop_liquid.

full_load_at_site_conditions.description: Whether full-load cooling capability at site conditions is explicitly required.

water_percent.description: Required percentage of water in the coolant mixture.

glycol_percent.description: Required percentage of glycol in the coolant mixture.

maximum_external_radiator_pressure_drop_.description: Maximum permitted external radiator pressure drop normalized to inches of water gauge.

lubrication_system.description: The required lubrication pump, oil cooler, and filtration characteristics.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation or quotations that state the lubrication requirements.

source_page.description: One-based PDF page containing the primary source_text.

gear_type_pump.description: Whether a gear-type oil pump is explicitly required.

positive_displacement_pump.description: Whether a positive-displacement oil pump is explicitly required.

full_pressure_lubrication.description: Whether full-pressure lubrication is explicitly required.

water_cooled_oil_cooler.description: Whether a water-cooled oil cooler is explicitly required.

particle_removal_efficiency_percent.description: Required minimum particle-removal efficiency as a percentage.

particle_size_micrometers.description: Largest particle size covered by the stated removal efficiency, normalized to micrometers.

full_flow_fail_safe_filtration.description: Whether full-flow fail-safe filtration is explicitly required.

maximum_ambient_temperature.description: Maximum ambient temperature requirement for the complete generator system.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation that states the maximum ambient temperature requirement.

value_celsius.description: Maximum ambient temperature normalized to degrees Celsius.

minimum_ambient_temperature.description: Minimum ambient temperature requirement for the complete generator system.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation that states the minimum ambient temperature requirement.

value_celsius.description: Minimum ambient temperature normalized to degrees Celsius.

relative_humidity.description: Relative-humidity operating requirement for the complete generator system.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation that states the relative-humidity requirement.

minimum_percent_rh.description: Minimum relative humidity normalized to percent RH.

maximum_percent_rh.description: Maximum relative humidity normalized to percent RH.

altitude.description: Minimum required altitude capability for the generator system.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation that states the altitude or elevation capability.

minimum_capability_meters.description: Minimum altitude capability normalized to meters above sea level.

generator_control_ambient_rating.description: Ambient temperature and humidity rating required for generator controls.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation or quotations that state the generator-control ambient rating.

source_page.description: One-based PDF page containing the primary source_text.

battery_charger_ambient_rating.description: Ambient temperature and humidity rating required for the battery charger.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation or quotations that state the battery-charger ambient rating.

source_page.description: One-based PDF page containing the primary source_text.

voltage_regulator_ambient_rating.description: Ambient temperature rating required for the voltage regulator.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation that states the voltage-regulator ambient rating.

engine_governing_control_ambient_rating.description: Ambient temperature and humidity rating required for the engine governing control.

source_text.description: Shortest exact quotation or quotations that state the engine-governing-control ambient rating.

source_page.description: One-based PDF page containing the primary source_text.
